CSX CRISIS COMMUNICATIONS / HAZARDOUS MATERIALS MANAGER, WAS CONFERENCED IN WITH CALLER, AND ADVISED ENVIRONMENTAL CONTRACTORS WOULD BE NOTIFIED AND RESPONDING FOR CLEAN-UP. DISPATCHER PRESCOTT, BETHLEHEM POLICE DEPARTMENT, WAS ALSO NOTIFIED, AND ADVISED NO RESPONSE WAS NEEDED.
